subject: pe
title: Goal Setting and Self-Efficacy
welcome_lead: Locke and Latham, Bandura — set targets, build belief.
meta_desc: A-Level PE adventure on SMART goals and self-efficacy.
final_note: Process goals + frequent feedback = the formula for confidence growth.

concepts.def: Locke & Latham: specific, difficult goals drive performance via attention and effort.
Outcome focuses on results; process on technique/effort under control.
Bandura: belief in one's ability to perform a task.
Past success — strongest source of self-efficacy.
Encouragement from credible others; modest efficacy source.

walkthroughs.body_html: Specific, difficult goals outperform 'do your best' instructions, provided commitment and feedback exist.
SMART operationalises goal setting in coaching — 'run 5 km under 25 min within 6 weeks' is SMART.
Mastery, vicarious experience, verbal persuasion, physiological/emotional state — ranked by strength.
